players.product: Data-center electrical distribution equipment (the 'powertrain'): medium/low-voltage switchgear and switchboards, transformers, automatic transfer switches, PDUs, eHouses and prefabricated modular power skids (Powertrain Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal Q4 2026 results release: Forgent announced a $35 million investment to expand Powertrain Solutions manufacturing capacity at its Tijuana, Mexico campus (the '2027 PTS Capacity Expansion'), incremental to the 2025-2026 Capacity Expansion, which is now substantially complete. Q4 capital expenditures were $31 million, substantially all for the 2025-2026 Capacity Expansion; fiscal 2027 capital expenditures are expected to total approximately $87 million, including remaining spend on the 2025-2026 expansion, the PTS expansion and maintenance capital expenditures of approximately 1% of revenues. CEO Gary Niederpruem: Powertrain Solutions revenue grew 259% in fiscal 2026 and 'accounted for nearly one-third of fourth quarter revenue, significantly exceeding the demand assumptions underlying our initial capacity build-out.'
quarterly_data.figure: $35 million Tijuana PTS capacity investment; Q4 capex $31 million; fiscal 2027 capex approximately $87 million

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal Q4 2026 results release: GAAP net income was $66 million in the quarter (net income margin 14.3%) and $106 million for fiscal 2026, up 508%; Q4 cash flow from operations $74 million. The book-to-bill ratio rose to 3.3x in the fourth quarter from 2.3x in the third quarter. The company expects quarterly revenue and Adjusted EBITDA to increase consecutively through fiscal 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 net income $66 million; FY2026 net income $106 million (+508%); book-to-bill 2.3x in fiscal Q3
